Inputs

Values recalculate as you type. Slip is a percentage (enter 6 for 6%). Drive efficiency is a fraction from 0 to 1. Frequencies must satisfy Min ≤ Standard ≤ Max. Enter the motor nameplate: rated power, speed, frequency, Δ voltage and currents (0 = estimate from IE3). Delta is assumed to run on the 87 Hz characteristic. Starting torque available is a % of rated (about 150% on a VFD).

Enter the belt speed and throughput you want at the standard frequency. Target safety factor is available running force ÷ required force (1.5 is a typical margin). The motor is also sized to start the load against the breakaway friction and acceleration.

Star / delta on the VFD (87 Hz delta)

Base frequency star—Hz
Base frequency delta—Hz
Power star min / std / max—kW
Power delta min / std / max—kW

Both connections use the nameplate rating. The VFD holds V/f at the nameplate ratio, so each connection gives rated torque up to its base frequency. Star reaches the supply voltage at about the rated frequency, then field-weakens (torque × base/f, power stays rated). Delta reaches it at about 87 Hz, so it keeps rated torque and its power rises with frequency, up to √3 × rated at 87 Hz.

The VFD starts at low frequency, below either base frequency, so star and delta have the same starting torque. Breakaway uses the static friction coefficient; acceleration brings the whole moving mass to belt speed in the set time. Motor and gearbox rotating inertia is not included.

Overload setting = rated current of the chosen connection. In 87 Hz delta the VFD must be rated for the delta current (√3 × star).

Recommendation

— : 1 gearbox exact requirement — : 1
— kW star needs — kW · rated — A
— kW delta (87 Hz) needs — kW · rated — A

Sized by running. Nearest standard gearbox ratio, then the next standard IEC nameplate rating for each connection that meets both the running safety factor at the standard frequency and the starting torque. Up to about 50 Hz both connections need the same motor; above it, star field-weakens and needs a larger motor, while 87 Hz delta keeps rated torque. Amps are IE3 estimates.

Constants

1 N = 0.101971621297793 kgf
(standard gravity g = 9.80665 m/s²)

√3 = 1.7320508

Safety-factor bands: ≥ 1.5 OK, 1.0–1.5 marginal, < 1.0 the drive cannot move the load.

Motor & drive speed

s = 1 - N_rated / (120 × f_rated / p)

N_motor = (f × 120 / p) × (1 - s)   [rpm]
          evaluated at f_min, f_std, f_max

N_drive = N_motor / i                 [rpm]

Slip from the nameplate rated speed, held at the same fraction on the VFD.

Motor rated torque

T_rated = P × 1000 / (2π × N_rated / 60)   [Nm]

From the nameplate power and speed. The same for star and delta: each connection puts the rated voltage on the windings when it is on its base frequency.

Star / delta on the VFD (87 Hz delta)

f_base,star  = f_rated × (V/√3) / VΔ
f_base,delta = f_rated × V / VΔ
               (50 × 400/230 ≈ 87 Hz)

factor(f) = 1             f ≤ f_base
          = f_base / f    f > f_base

T_conn(f) = T_rated × factor(f)
P_conn(f) = T_conn(f) × 2π N_motor(f) / 60

The VFD holds V/f at the nameplate ratio until its output reaches the supply voltage V. Above that base frequency the motor field-weakens: torque falls as base/f and power stays at its value at base. Delta reaches base at √3 × the star frequency, so it delivers up to √3 × rated power at 87 Hz. No star-delta starting is modelled.

Drive torque & force

T_drive = T_conn(f_std) × i × ηd   [Nm]

F       = T_drive / (r / 1000)     [N]
F[kgf]  = F[N] × 0.101972

Conveyor geometry & speed

C = 2 × π × r / 1000        [m]

v = C × N_drive,std           [m/min]

cycles/min = (v / C) × 2

Crop load & throughput

m_crop     = h × L × w × ρ    [kg]
loading    = h × w × ρ        [kg/m]
feed       = loading × v      [kg/min]
throughput = feed × 60 / 1000 [t/h]

Running force & payload

m_total = m_shaft + m_belt + m_crop

F_friction = μ × cosθ × m_total   [kgf]
F_lift     = sinθ × m_crop           [kgf]
F_req      = F_friction + F_lift
F[N]       = F[kgf] / 0.101972

payload    = F[kgf] - F_req

Friction acts on the whole load resting on the bed. Only the crop is lifted: the shaft is stationary and the belt's return run cancels its own lift. Negative θ (downhill) makes the lift negative, reducing or reversing the required force.

Running torque, power & safety factor

T_run = F_req[N] × (r/1000) / (i × ηd)   [Nm]
P_run = T_run × 2π N_motor,std / 60000      [kW]

SF_run = F_conn[kgf] / F_req
         at f_std, and at f_max

P_run is the power the conveyor absorbs at the motor shaft. SF is ∞ when the load needs no driving force (downhill).

Starting

a       = (v / 60) / t_acc               [m/s²]

F_start = μs × cosθ × m_total
        + sinθ × m_crop
        + m_total × a × 0.101972       [kgf]

T_start = F_start[N] × (r/1000) / (i × ηd)

T_avail  = T_rated × start% / 100
SF_start = T_avail / T_start

P_start = T_start / (start%/100) × 2π N_rated / 60000

μs is the breakaway (static) friction coefficient; start% is the torque the VFD allows (typically 150%). The VFD starts below either base frequency, so star and delta have the same starting torque. P_start is the smallest nameplate rating that can start the load. Rotating inertia is not included.

Sizing — gear ratio

N_drive,req = v_target / C          [rpm]

i_exact = N_motor,std / N_drive,req
i_std   = nearest of standard series
  5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15, 20, 25, 30,
  35, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 100

Sizing — motor power

loading = (tph × 1000 / 60) / v_target  [kg/m]
m_crop  = loading × L

T_rated,conn = max( SF_target × T_run / factor_conn(f_std),
                    T_start / (start% / 100) )

P_conn = T_rated,conn × 2π N_rated / 60000

next standard IEC size up:
  0.12, 0.18, 0.25, 0.37, 0.55, 0.75,
  1.1, 1.5, 2.2, 3, 4, 5.5, 7.5,
  11, 15, 18.5, 22 kW

T_run and T_start use the exact ratio. Up to the star base frequency both connections need the same nameplate rating; above it star needs more, while 87 Hz delta does not.

Sizing — check with standard picks

N_drive = N_motor,std / i_std
v_actual = C × N_drive
tph_actual = loading × v_actual × 60/1000

speed error = (v_actual - v_target)
              / v_target × 100%

SF running and starting: forward equations
re-run with i_std and the standard kW,
keeping the same loading [kg/m]

Motor current

I_star  = nameplate Y current
I_delta = nameplate Δ current

estimate when not entered:
I_star  = P × 1000 / (√3 × √3VΔ × η × pf)
I_delta = √3 × I_star

overload setting = rated current
for the chosen connection

rated speed      0 < N_rated < 120 f_rated / p
drive efficiency 0 < ηd ≤ 1
inclination      -89° to +89°
friction         μ, μs ≥ 0
rated currents   ≥ 0 (0 = estimate)
all dimensions, masses, density,
power, voltages, ratio, speed,
accel time, start %, target SF > 0
